note: The 32 answer_only problems have NO reasoning trace anywhere in the archive. Over 256 fresh draws at a 4096-token budget they yielded 116 correct completions at a median of 139 tokens with no reasoning, and 32 that reasoned -- and those 32 were exactly the ones that hit the budget. Zero draws were both correct and deriving.
